packageRules.description: The Sigma toolchain (detections/requirements.txt + docker/validation/zircolite-constraints.txt) moves as ONE PR: pySigma, pyparsing and the backends are coupled, so per-package PRs would each go red waiting for the others. Every bump runs the corpus through the hard gates; a red one is the intended conversation, so it is never automerged (#322).

pysigma-backend-sqlite 2.1.0 moved to pySigma 2 (pysigma>=2.0.0,<3) while sigma-cli, the splunk/elasticsearch/kusto backends and zircolite's pipelines still require pysigma<2, so bumping the backend alone makes the constrained install in sigma-validation.yml ResolutionImpossible (#354 did exactly that and main's host plane went red). Hold it below 2.1.0 until pySigma 2 lands across the toolchain; the PR that moves pysigma to 2.x in both files drops this rule.
